title: Toolara Audio
subtitle: Transcribe any recording into clean text, or turn any text into natural speech — in seconds.
descTranscribe: Upload an audio file and get a text transcript.
descSynthesize: Enter text and generate speech audio.
uploadText: Click to upload or drag an audio file
faq1a: Yes. It runs on Cloudflare Workers AI with a free daily quota. Normal use won't hit limits.
faq2a: No. Audio is processed in memory and discarded immediately after the transcript or speech is generated. Nothing is stored.
faq3q: What audio formats work for transcription?
faq3a: MP3, WAV, M4A, and most common audio formats. Maximum file size is 25MB.
faq4a: MeloTTS supports English, Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, and Korean. Output is WAV audio.
faq5a: OpenAI Whisper is one of the most accurate speech recognition models available. Accuracy depends on audio quality and background noise. For best results, use clear recordings.
disclaimer: Note: AI transcription and synthesis are provided as-is. Review output before using it in production or official documents.
footer: Runs on Cloudflare Workers AI. Your audio is not stored.
outEmptyHint: Your transcript or generated speech will appear here
outNote: Processed in memory — nothing is stored.
examplesText: This 5-second clip was generated by our Text-to-Speech — then transcribed back by our Speech-to-Text. Real output, both ways.
how1d: Drop in an audio file, or paste the text you want to hear.
how2d: Whisper transcribes speech to text; MeloTTS speaks your text in 7 languages.
how3d: Copy the transcript, or download the generated speech as an audio file.
use1d: Turn recordings into clean, searchable notes.
use2d: Get full transcripts you can quote and archive.
use3d: Hear any phrase spoken aloud in 7 languages.
use4d: Create read-aloud versions of any written text.
